map.朔望月周期约为 29.53 天。从新月到满月为\"上弦\"阶段（渐盈），从满月到: The synodic month is about 29.53 days. From new moon to full moon is the "waxing" phase; from full moon to new moon is the "waning" phase. Moon age is the number of days since the last new moon: 0 is new moon and about 14.76 is full moon.
map.由视星等与距离算绝对星等、历法等。: Compute absolute magnitude from apparent magnitude and distance, plus ephemeris, etc.
map.观测前估算目标天体是否落在肉眼或望远镜的可见范围内。: Before observing, estimate whether a target object falls within naked-eye or telescope visibility.
map.按 Collins–Melosh–Marcus 标度律估算陨石撞击坑直径、动能与: Estimate meteorite impact-crater diameter, kinetic energy and Hiroshima equivalents using the Collins–Melosh–Marcus scaling law (educational order of magnitude).
map.公式 M=m-5(log₁₀d-1)；太阳视星等 m=-26.74、d=1AU: Formula M=m-5(log₁₀d-1); the Sun has apparent magnitude m=-26.74 at d=1 AU → M≈4.83.
map.铁陨石 L=50 m、ρᵢ=7800 kg/m³、v=13 km/s、45° 入: Iron meteorite L=50 m, ρᵢ=7800 kg/m³, v=13 km/s, 45° impact, target rock ρₜ=2700 kg/m³ → transient crater ≈1.22 km (Barringer Crater measured 1.19 km), kinetic energy ≈4.3×10¹⁶ J (about 684× Hiroshima).
map.是，每差 5 等亮度差 100 倍。: Yes; a difference of 5 magnitudes means 100× in brightness.
map.m−M=5·lg d−5，用于由视星等与距离推绝对星等（d 以 pc 计）。: m−M=5·lg d−5, used to derive absolute magnitude from apparent magnitude and distance (d in pc).
map.按 CMM 标度律 D=1.161·(ρᵢ/ρₜ)^(1/3)·L^0.78·v: Use the CMM scaling law D=1.161·(ρᵢ/ρₜ)^(1/3)·L^0.78·v^0.44·g^−0.22·sin^(1/3)θ for the transient crater; when it exceeds 2.5 km, convert to the final collapsed crater via D_fr=1.17·D_tc^1.13/D_c^0.13.
